newsitem.title: INDIA: Four killed, five trapped in Indian mine collapse.
newsitem.headline: Four killed, five trapped in Indian mine collapse.

text.p: At least four people were killed and 13 injured when a coal mine collapsed in India's northern state of Jammu and Kashmir, an official spokesman said on Tuesday.
"There were 22 miners working inside at the time of the collapse. Five are still trapped inside," the spokesman said.
The mine caved in on Monday in Rajouri district, 133 km (83 miles) from Jammu, the winter capital of the Himalayan state. Rescue operations by local authorities were continuing, the spokesman said.
The Press Trust of India agency said at least nine people were believed to have been killed.
